description: Put a prompt to every seat of one collection at once and get every answer back, each under its seat and model, plus the seats as data (alias, seat, status, call id). Can take minutes. Ask a collection, not a favourite model. Give the seats the real text (code, diff, file contents) in the prompt: they cannot read your files. Verify every claim against the source before acting on it, name every seat that answered in what you tell the user, then send a verdict per seat you judged.

merged.description: true: one reconciled answer, every seat still called and listed; false: every answer. Omit for the collection's own.

prompt.description: The question, with everything it needs.

system.description: A system message for every seat.

with.description: Model aliases to seat in explorer chairs, this request only.
